# PCIe 8-pin (female) to 2 x 6+2-pin splitter cable

| Role | feeds two riser boards (75 W each) from one PSU 6+2 lead |

| Systems | node |

The PSU has six 6+2 leads, but the GPUs (7900 XTX 2, B60 1, B70 1) and the seven
risers need eleven. Use splitters only on riser leads, never on a GPU's own
connector: 2 x 75 W stays within one 150 W 8-pin rating.

## Model

- Source: constructed
- Assembly: **not in the assembly**: flexible cable

## Datasheets

- None recorded. Generic cable; choose 16 AWG and check the PSU lead is rated for both loads (2 x 75 W).
